Claim 1 (currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium comprising __water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

Claim 2 (original): The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water. (Original)

Claim 3 (currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to __at least one cycle of__ cold __temperature__, then heat followed by agitation.

Claim 4 (original): The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated. (Original)

Claim 5 (currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __applying heat to__ the shed cellular material and agitation.

Claim 6 (original): The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated. (Original)

Claim 7 (original): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme. (Original)

Claim 8 (original): The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@. (Original)

Claim 9 (currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA by __using the DNA extraction methods commonly used in the art__. 

Claim 10 (original): The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material. (Original)

Claim 11 (original): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos. (Original)

Claim 12 (original): The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d). (Original)

Claim 13 (original): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping. (Original)

Claim 14 (original): The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads. (Original)

Claim 15 (original): The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant. (Original)

Claim 16 (original): The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed. (Original)

Claim 17 (original): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype. (Original)

Claim 18 (original): The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos. (Original)

Claim 19 (original): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos __and/or germination__ is automated. (Original)
